The initial 2027 forecast totals EUR 286,000. Personnel accounts for EUR 174,000, infrastructure EUR 48,000, travel and dissemination EUR 31,000, external services EUR 21,000, and training EUR 12,000. The figure excludes new hires dependent on calls that have not yet been resolved.

Priority needs are renewal of the research engineering contract, storage expansion, support for two GPUs, and mandatory LUMEN and VERDANT meetings. ARIADNA also requests funding for external human evaluation. The knowledge-representation and language lines propose a shared budget for annotation and terminology review.

Clara will ask every lead for a justification and a reduced alternative. Elena will review priorities by 30 April. The baseline budget must distinguish confirmed, requested, and unidentified funding. No recurring cost will be assigned to a funding source whose duration is shorter than the commitment.
